motions.motion: Board Member Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of the Governing Board of the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency, Designating a Survey Area and Authorizing the Preparation of a Draft Community Reinvestment Project Area Plan and Budget for the Proposed Sweetwater Industrial Park Community Reinvestment Project Area #4. Board Member Clark seconded the motion.
